description: This file defines the PunchOutMenuConfigurator class responsible for configuring menu items related to the Punch Out functionality in the OrangeHRM attendance module. It implements a configuration interface and overrides certain module and screen settings.

classes.name: PunchOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class implementing menu configuration for Punch Out functionality in the attendance module, using traits to manipulate module and screen context.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the module to 'time' and screen to 'punchIn' for the current context, returning null.
